title: Yuukyuu no Kobako Official Collection
overview: Yuukyuu no Kobako is one of several Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku fan discs. This one features a variety of high-quality videos and illustrations from the first game, as well as a many illustrations and information as a preview of the then-upcoming Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku: 2nd Album. Also included is a quiz mode where you can test your knowledge of the characters and the world of the games.
